description: Terminal-Bench style sshd hardening: block the contractor user spike from SSH entirely by adding a global DenyUsers spike to etc/ssh/sshd_config while changing nothing else; the gate parses the config with sshd first-obtained-value and Match semantics and verifies every other user keeps exactly the previous effective settings (SHA-256 digests).

criteria: etc/ssh/sshd_config gained a global DenyUsers spike that applies to every connection; spike is denied while root, dana, lee and ruz keep byte-identical effective settings, the Match Group contractors block stays and passwd/group/README/gate are untouched.
